blocks.text:
## Colombia: the river of five colours

The journey begins in Bogotá: gold artefacts from pre-Columbian civilisations, the old streets of La Candelaria and views of the capital from Monserrate. Next comes a walk in the Chicaque cloud forest, with waterfalls and mountain trails.

The main part of the trip takes place in La Macarena. Two separate excursions reveal the upper and lower reaches of Caño Cristales, where Macarenia clavigera aquatic plants colour the clear river in different shades. You will travel by canoe along the Guayabero, by 4x4 and on foot; along the way are natural pools and birdwatching spots. You will spend 3 nights at the rustic La Manigua Lodge.

## Hotels and prices

Price per person in US dollars, including 4 nights in Bogotá and 3 nights at La Manigua Lodge:

| Category | Hotel in Bogotá | Lodge near La Macarena | SGL | DBL | TRP |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| C | Faranda Express Belvedere | La Manigua | $6539 | $4586 | $4078 |
| S | Best Western Plus 93 | La Manigua | $6820 | $4800 | $4234 |
| P | Casa Dann Carlton | La Manigua | $7102 | $4992 | $4359 |

SGL means single occupancy, DBL double occupancy and TRP triple occupancy. Three separate beds are not guaranteed for TRP.

## Preparing for the trip

Routes in Caño Cristales include walks of up to 8–13 km over 5–7 hours on rocks and trails. Departures, entry times and river sections depend on decisions by the environmental authorities. You will need cash in Colombian pesos in La Macarena. Before booking, tell us about any mobility limitations, medical conditions or special dietary requirements.
